h1: Custom Cotton Napkins for Every Occasion
metaDescription: Order custom cotton napkins for your brand. Soft, absorbent, and perfect for events. Get a quote today.
introHtml: Cotton napkins offer a soft, absorbent feel that paper or polyester blends can't match. They're ideal for restaurants, catered events, or corporate gift sets where a premium touch matters. With embroidery or screen printing, your logo stays visible wash after wash. Choose from hemmed edges or decorative stitching for a polished look that elevates any table setting.
heroAltText: Stack of custom cotton napkins with embroidered logo in beige and white
